segments.name: Banking
products: lending to and receiving deposits from customers
segments.description: Provides commercial banking, lending and deposit-taking services to individuals, corporations and wealth management clients through Shinhan Bank and Jeju Bank.
segments.evidence: The banking services segment provides commercial banking and related services through the following four sub-segments:

segments.name: Credit card
products: short-term and long-term card loan services
segments.description: Issues credit cards and provides card loans, installment financing and leasing to retail cardholders and merchants through Shinhan Card.
segments.evidence: credit card services, which are principally provided by Shinhan Card;

segments.name: Securities
segments.description: Offers securities trading, consignment trading and underwriting services to investors and issuers through Shinhan Securities.
segments.evidence: securities services, which are provided by Shinhan Securities;

segments.name: Insurance
segments.description: Sells life insurance and non-life insurance protection products to policyholders through Shinhan Life Insurance and its insurance subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: insurance services, which are principally provided by Shinhan Life Insurance;

segments.name: Credit
segments.description: Provides facility rental and new technology business financing to corporate and equipment-using customers through Shinhan Capital.
segments.evidence: credit services, which are provided by Shinhan Capital;

segments.name: Others
segments.description: Covers real estate trust, investment advisory services, venture business investment and other remaining businesses outside the main segments.
segments.evidence: other services that do not belong to the above business segments.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay interest on loans and deposits and fees for banking, card, securities, asset management and insurance services provided by the group's subsidiaries.
revenueModel.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we have 15 direct and 32 indirect subsidiaries offering a wide range of financial products and services, including commercial banking, corporate banking, private banking, credit card, asset management, brokerage and insurance services.

changes.text: In 2024 Shinhan AI. Co., Ltd. was liquidated and dissolved, and it is no longer a subsidiary of the group.
changes.evidence: In July 2024, we announced the liquidation and dissolution of Shinhan AI. Co., Ltd., and such entity is no longer our subsidiary.
